measurements.plant_part: i) green parts (stems and leaves); ii) floral buds; iii) flowers in anthesis (fully open and functional flowers); iv) senescent flowers
measurements.origin: Northwest of Portugal (Riba de Mouro, Minho)
measurements.equipment: Dionex Ultimate 3000 UPLC (Thermo Scientific, San Jose, CA, USA) system equipped with a diode array detector coupled to a electrospray ionization mass detector (LC-DAD-ESI/MSn), a quaternary pump, an auto-sampler (kept at 5 ºC), a degasser and an automated thermostatted column compartment
measurements.citation: Bessada et al., 2016. Industrial Crops and Products, 89, 45-51.
